nodes.summary: Let $h \ge 2$. Write $R_h(n)$ for the largest size of a $B_h$-set contained in $\{1, \dots, n\}$ and $R_h^{-1}(k)$ for the least $n$ such that $\{1, \dots, n\}$ contains a $B_h$-set with $k$ elements. Then $R_h(n) \ge n^{1/h} - n^{21/(40h)}$ for all sufficiently large natural numbers $n$, and $R_h^{-1}(k) \le k^h + 2^h k^{h - 19/40}$ for all sufficiently large natural numbers $k$.

nodes.summary: There is a real number $x_0$ such that for every real $x \ge x_0$ there is a prime $p$ with $x - x^{21/40} \le p \le x$ and a prime $p'$ with $x \le p' \le x + x^{21/40}$.
nodes.title: Baker–Harman–Pintz theorem

nodes.summary: For every natural number $n > \exp(\exp(32.537))$ there is a prime $p$ with $n^3 < p < (n + 1)^3$.
nodes.title: Cully-Hugill's theorem for cubes

nodes.summary: For every natural number $n \ge 1$ there is a prime $p$ with $n^{155} < p < (n + 1)^{155}$.
nodes.title: Cully-Hugill's theorem for 155th powers

nodes.summary: Assume the Riemann Hypothesis. Then for every natural number $n \ge 2$ there is a prime $p$ with $n^2 < p < \bigl(n + (1 + 1/\log n)^2 \log n\bigr)^2$, where $\log$ is the natural logarithm.

nodes.summary: Let $h \ge 2$, let $F$ be a finite field with $q$ elements, let $K$ be a field extension of $F$ of degree $h$, let $\theta$ be a generator of the multiplicative group $K^\times$, and let $b$ be a natural number such that $\theta^b$ has degree $h$ over $F$. Then the generalized Bose set $\mathrm{Bose}_h(q, b)$, a subset of $\mathbb{Z}/(q^h - 1)\mathbb{Z}$, is a $B_h$-set with exactly $q$ elements.

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
